Nebius Group N.V. announced the results of its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders on August 26, 2026.
Nebius Group N.V. announced the closing of its private offering of 0.50% and 4.50% convertible senior notes.
Nebiüs Group N.V. announced pricing for an upsized private offering of $5.0 billion in convertible senior notes.
Nebiüs Group N.V. announced a $4.50 billion private offering of convertible senior notes.
Nebius Group N.V. filed its operating and financial review and unaudited financial statements for the periods ending June 30, 2025 and 2026.
Nebius Group N.V. filed unaudited Q2 2026 financial results and a shareholder letter on August 12, 2026.
Nebius Group N.V. announced its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders will be held on August 25, 2026.
Nebius Group N.V. secured a $775 million loan facility.
